caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with a dark brown or black cushioned seat and a wooden frame in a lighter brown tone. The chair has four legs that taper outward, connected by horizontal supports, and two armrests, also made of wood, that angle upward from the front legs to the backrest. The backrest consists of a horizontal upper rail connecting four vertical spindles, which are turned and spaced evenly. The chair is depicted against a plain, light-colored background with faint marks or speckles, and there are no other objects or decorations present. The artist's signature, "Frank W. Cutting," appears in small text in the bottom right corner.
title: High Chair (for infants)
